project.head: Project settings
project.name: Project name
project.sidebarDescription: Reorder modules and choose which appear in the sidebar. Locked items always stay enabled.
project.securityDescription: Password strength and login attempt limits

weak.label: Weak
weak.description: Minimum 6 characters. No mixed case, numbers, or symbols required.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Minimum 8 characters, with mixed case letters and at least one number.

strong.label: Strong
strong.description: Minimum 12 characters, mixed case, letters, numbers, symbols, and not found in known data breaches.

project.registrationDescription: Control public sign-up and defaults for new accounts
project.allowedDomainsHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to allow any domain.

project.presetEmpty: No presets yet. Add at least one before saving.

project.presetDimensionsRequired: Set at least width or height.
